notes: Relay now tracks multiple game peers and deterministically routes ACT/INTERACT/CAPTURE/EDIT to an active controller (observers excluded).
HELLO protocol remains backward compatible; new optional fields supported: mode, clientLabel, sessionId, controllerPriority.
Bridge ownership metadata is attached to OBS.bridge and controller lifecycle events are emitted in OBS.events (bridge_controller_acquired/lost).
Run harness now marks snapshot tabs observer-only and tags keepalive with explicit controller identity/priority.
Playtest controller gained startup no-progress watchdog plus bridge ownership logging; near-target guidance interact behavior was hardened to prevent 2.4m deadlocks.
